Shadowburn

Tooltip

Instantly blasts the target for 266 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 8 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

How it works

Each cast of Shadowburn costs 365 Mana. Casting it triggers a 1.5 sec global cooldown.

Shadowburn is built from 2 client effects, applied in this order:

  1. Effect 1 is Apply Aura (effect type 6). It applies aura type 86. Its base value is 1. It scales with 1 times spell power.
  2. Effect 2 is School Damage (effect type 2). Its base value is 266. It scales with 0.429 times spell power.

What it does

Shadowburn is a Shadow spell with an instant cast, a range of 30 yards, a 15 sec cooldown and effects that last 8 sec. When cast it applies an aura and deals Shadow damage (base value 266).

Generated from the SpellEffect, SpellMisc, SpellCooldowns and SpellRange records in the WoW Forever beta client, build 1.60.1.70450. Effects the client marks as internal hooks are left out.
